title: Exhaustive provenance coverage requires a retained ref-and-history manifest
purpose: Define the minimum evidence needed before M-004, M-005, or M-006 may be classified as unlocated, without promoting incomplete search results into absence claims.

observed: The active queue requires exhaustive branch inventory or equivalent repository history traversal before any disputed identifier may be classified as unlocated.
CM-1021 permits origin_status=unlocated only after retained exhaustive coverage closes every accepted search domain.
Repository code search for M-004, M-005, and M-006 returned no indexed matches in this run, but indexed search is not equivalent to exhaustive history traversal.
No retained ref-and-history coverage manifest currently exists in the inspected continuity records.
inferred: A reproducible absence conclusion requires both object coverage and traversal-accounting evidence.

Ref discovery, reachable-commit traversal, path inspection, and external approved-source review must remain separately auditable because failure in one domain cannot be repaired by success in another.
proposed: Use coverage_manifest_contract as the required envelope for future exhaustive traversals.
Retain raw ref inventory, traversal command or API method, commit counts, deduplication rule, termination evidence, tool limits, and per-domain completion status.
Keep M-004, M-005, and M-006 unresolved until every required domain is complete and every candidate has been evaluated under CM-1021.
superseded: Treating a repository-wide indexed search with zero matches as exhaustive absence.
Treating default-branch history as equivalent to all accessible refs.
Treating a traversal without retained termination and limit evidence as reproducibly exhaustive.
unresolved: The complete accessible ref inventory has not been retained.
The set of all reachable commits has not been retained or independently reproduced.
Approved non-repository provenance domains have not been exhaustively inventoried.
The origin events for M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unresolved.

required_evidence: all accessible branch and tag refs
complete reachable commit SHA set or content-addressed artifact
independent reproduction or explicit single-client limitation

coverage_manifest_contract.completion_rule: coverage_status may become exhaustive only when every required domain is complete, every provider or permission limit is recorded as non-material or resolved, traversal termination is retained, and the result is independently reproducible or explicitly marked single-client with no absence promotion.
coverage_manifest_contract.absence_rule: An identifier may become unlocated_after_exhaustive_coverage only when coverage_status=exhaustive and all inspected candidates fail CM-1021 with retained candidate-specific reasons.
coverage_manifest_contract.fail_closed_rule: Any unknown ref, truncated page, inaccessible source class, missing termination proof, unresolved namespace collision, or unreproduced traversal preserves coverage_status=incomplete and origin_status=unresolved.
coverage_manifest_contract.no_reconstruction_rule: Missing historical identifiers must not be recreated, renumbered, or assigned retroactively to satisfy continuity expectations.

falsification_routes: Produce an accessible ref omitted by a manifest classified exhaustive.
Produce a reachable commit absent from the retained reachable-commit set.
Show that a provider or permission ceiling was material but classified non-material.
Produce an immutable origin object that passes CM-1021 after an identifier was classified unlocated.
Demonstrate that the retained traversal cannot be independently reproduced from its recorded methods and artifacts.
